newsitem.title: JAPAN: Economist says NYMEX light crude could hit $30.
newsitem.headline: Economist says NYMEX light crude could hit $30.

text.p: The price of New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) light crude may soar to $30 following news of the U.S. military's cruise missile strike against air-defence targets in Iraq on Tuesday, said Kazuaki Kondo, a senior economist at the Japanese Institute of Middle Eastern Economies.
Kondo, who was speaking on a Reuters Financial Television programme, did not give a time frame.
NYMEX crude oil for October rose 22 cents to $23.70 shortly after the Pentagon announced that the United States had launched the missiles.
